name: Greenhawk Resources Inc.
summary: Greenhawk Resources Inc. is a company primarily engaged in mineral exploration activities within Greenland. The firm possesses full ownership, a 100% interest, in three distinct licenses associated with the Storo Gold Project: two for mineral exploration and one for prospecting. Notably, the company underwent a name change in May 2021, previously operating as Cryptologic Corp. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Toronto, Canada.
